要殖民一颗£planet£行星，点击你的殖民船，或者在总览窗口中选中它。然后在其舰队界面中点击殖民按钮，并选择你想殖民的星球。注意你只能在已调查并且没有异常点的星球上殖民。星球也必须位于你的境内。虽然你可以选择在宜居性较低的星球上殖民，但代价会非常高昂。

texts.en:
We should now use our new £colony_ship£ Colony Ship to establish our first £colony£ Colony. The best planetary candidates are those that are of the same planet class as our homeworld - our colonists will have no problems adjusting to their environments.

To colonize a £planet£ Planet, click on your Colony Ship or select it in the Outliner. Then click on the Colonize button in its fleet interface, and select the planet you want to colonize. Note that you can only colonize planets that have been surveyed and have no Anomalies. They must also be located within your borders. While you can choose to colonize low Habitability planets, doing so can be very expensive.
